card.name: Digits and gaps in stats and commands
card.fires_on: Fires on a space or digit just before a number in HIV statistics, and on the gap or prompt after a file path in SELinux shell commands. It also fires on the digit 7 inside HIV mutation codes such as T74P.

modes.label: HIV prevalence numbers
modes.description: A space or digit right before or inside a percentage in HIV epidemic statistics.

modes.label: Mutation codes
modes.description: The digit 7 inside a drug-resistance mutation code in a list.

modes.label: Shell command output
modes.description: The space or prompt after a file path in SELinux restorecon or ls commands.
modes.example: # restorecon -Rv /srv/www<< >>The SELinux policies here use regular expressions

card.plain: It marks spots in numbers and command lines where a new figure or a new line of output comes next.
